hospitals.notes: Official apollohospitals.com (all subdomains incl. delhi.apollohospitals.com, mediacdn) returned HTTP 403 (Azure gateway) for every page, so no official evidence could be captured. Only evidence is a NewsVoir press release carried by The Tribune with an 'Advertorial Disclaimer' tag (hospital-supplied content). Search snippets (not fetched/verified) indicated: an Apollo Delhi thrombectomy procedure page exists; Angels Initiative lists the hospital as a comprehensive (thrombectomy-performing) centre with 2024 awards; address in snippets 'Mathura Rd, Sarita Vihar, New Delhi 110076'. Reviewer should confirm address/phone/thrombectomy/stroke unit from the official site manually. Unfetched candidate names seen in search snippets of official profiles: Dr Anoop Kohli (founder co-ordinator, cerebrovascular diseases & stroke unit per snippet), Dr Rakesh Agarwal - not recorded as physicians because pages could not be fetched.

Ownership 'private' is general knowledge of Fortis Healthcare (listed company), not from a fetched source - reviewer to confirm. CT/MRI evidence is from a single patient-case news story. Unfetched search snippets suggested: Dr Jaideep Bansal listed on Fortis site as Principal Director & HOD Neurology at this campus; Fortis site has an 'interventional neurology' doctor listing for this campus; Angels Initiative lists it as a comprehensive (thrombectomy) centre. None recorded as claims because pages could not be fetched. Dr Sonal Gupta (HOD Neuro and Spine Surgery) appears in news but is a neurosurgeon - excluded per brief.
